settings.content: Controls the presentation of snippets/card-product.liquid. Sale/sold-out badge color, position, and corner radius are shared with the theme's global Badges settings above.

settings.label: Default image ratio
settings.info: Used when a section doesn't explicitly set its own image ratio.

settings.label: Custom badge color scheme (e.g. "NEW")
settings.info: Used for the badge driven by the product's custom.badge_text metafield. Falls back to the Sale badge color scheme above if not set.

settings.label: Link vendor name to its collection
settings.info: Links to /collections/{vendor-handle} when a matching collection exists.

settings.label: Sale price color
settings.info: Applies to the active/discounted price shown when a product is on sale.

settings.label: Compare-at price color
settings.info: Applies to the struck-through original price shown next to a sale price.

settings.label: Static message text
settings.info: e.g. "[Buy more, save more] Up to 20% off at checkout"

settings.label: Low stock threshold
settings.info: Shows "Only X left" when inventory is at or below this number.

settings.content: Cart Progress Thresholds are set in Market Metafields

settings.label: Pre-Goal Message
settings.info: Message displayed before reaching the goal. Use [remaining_for_goal] to insert the dynamic remaining amount.

settings.label: Post-Goal Message
settings.info: Message displayed after reaching the goal.

settings.label: Progress Bar Full Color
settings.info: Color of the progress bar when complete.

settings.label: Progress Bar Background Color
settings.info: Color of the progress bar background.
